$comment: The AI apps Surehand MCP connects to: one list for the server (names), the Windows Setup's Choose AI apps page and the Mac Installer's Installation Type choices (installer/ai-apps.mjs), in this order. id: the server's client id (surehand-ae connect <id>). mac: where the Mac Installer looks for the app (~ is the home folder); the server's own test (server/src/cli/clients.ts clientInstalled) is what Windows uses. web: ChatGPT on the web, which needs cloudflared (optional, never ticked by default).
